blocks.text: Śiva Sūtras 1.12
blocks.directed: [long pause] Śiva Sūtras 1.12

blocks.text: विस्मयो योगभूमिकाः
blocks.directed: [slowly] विस्मयो योगभूमिकाः

blocks.text: Vismayo yogabhūmikāḥ.
blocks.directed: Vismayo yogabhūmikāḥ.

blocks.text: The stages of yoga are wonder.
blocks.directed: The stages of yoga are wonder.

blocks.text: Enlightenment Is Apparently Going “WHAT THE ACTUAL HELL” Forever.
blocks.directed: Enlightenment Is Apparently Going “WHAT THE ACTUAL HELL” Forever.

blocks.text: This is absolutely gorgeous.
blocks.directed: This is absolutely gorgeous.

blocks.text: Vismaya means wonder, astonishment, amazement.
blocks.directed: Vismaya means wonder, astonishment, amazement.

blocks.text: Yoga is union or spiritual integration.
blocks.directed: Yoga is union or spiritual integration.

blocks.text: Bhūmikāḥ are stages, levels, or grounds.
blocks.directed: Bhūmikāḥ are stages, levels, or grounds.

blocks.text: Now you might expect Vasugupta to give us a complicated hierarchy.
blocks.directed: Now you might expect Vasugupta to give us a complicated hierarchy.

blocks.text: Level one: mild bliss.
blocks.directed: Level one: mild bliss.

blocks.text: Level two: unusual forehead sensations.
blocks.directed: Level two: unusual forehead sensations.

blocks.text: Level three: a very impressive dream about serpents.
blocks.directed: Level three: a very impressive dream about serpents.

blocks.text: Level four: you start wearing white linen.
blocks.directed: Level four: you start wearing white linen.

blocks.text: No.
blocks.directed: No.

blocks.text: He says wonder.
blocks.directed: He says wonder.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja explains that the extraordinary yogi encounters ever-renewed astonishment in the manifestation of reality.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja explains that the extraordinary yogi encounters ever-renewed astonishment in the manifestation of reality.

blocks.text: Not because everything is mysterious in the sense of being incomprehensible.
blocks.directed: Not because everything is mysterious in the sense of being incomprehensible.

blocks.text: But because consciousness continually reveals its own extraordinary nature.
blocks.directed: But because consciousness continually reveals its own extraordinary nature.

blocks.text: What previously appeared mundane becomes marvellous.
blocks.directed: What previously appeared mundane becomes marvellous.

blocks.text: A sound.
blocks.directed: A sound.

blocks.text: A colour.
blocks.directed: A colour.

blocks.text: The sensation of breathing.
blocks.directed: The sensation of breathing.

blocks.text: The manifestation of a thought.
blocks.directed: The manifestation of a thought.

blocks.text: Each is an expression of the same inexhaustible reality.
blocks.directed: Each is an expression of the same inexhaustible reality.

blocks.text: The yogi discovers something rather surprising.
blocks.directed: The yogi discovers something rather surprising.

blocks.text: Recognition does not necessarily make the world less interesting.
blocks.directed: Recognition does not necessarily make the world less interesting.

blocks.text: It makes the world infinitely more astonishing.
blocks.directed: It makes the world infinitely more astonishing.

blocks.text: Because the object is no longer merely an object.
blocks.directed: Because the object is no longer merely an object.

blocks.text: It is an expression of Śakti.
blocks.directed: It is an expression of Śakti.

blocks.text: And this is not wonder that depends on finding something new and exotic.
blocks.directed: And this is not wonder that depends on finding something new and exotic.

blocks.text: It’s wonder at what has been right in front of you the entire time.
blocks.directed: It’s wonder at what has been right in front of you the entire time.

blocks.text: Imagine a man studying a lamp.
blocks.directed: Imagine a man studying a lamp.

blocks.text: He understands the electricity.
blocks.directed: He understands the electricity.

blocks.text: He understands the circuitry.
blocks.directed: He understands the circuitry.

blocks.text: He understands the filament.
blocks.directed: He understands the filament.

blocks.text: But suddenly there is an astonishment at the very fact that anything whatsoever manifests.
blocks.directed: But suddenly there is an astonishment at the very fact that anything whatsoever manifests.

blocks.text: Not merely, “How does this device work?”
blocks.directed: Not merely, “How does this device work?”

blocks.text: But, “What is this astonishing reality in which the device, the observer, and the act of knowing appear?”
blocks.directed: But, “What is this astonishing reality in which the device, the observer, and the act of knowing appear?”

blocks.text: The answer isn’t conceptual bewilderment.
blocks.directed: The answer isn’t conceptual bewilderment.

blocks.text: It’s camatkāra — the aesthetic and experiential astonishment so beloved in the Kashmiri tradition.
blocks.directed: It’s camatkāra — the aesthetic and experiential astonishment so beloved in the Kashmiri tradition.

blocks.text: Kṣemarāja even stresses that these stages are not simply a checklist of unusual yogic sensations. They concern the ever-fresh wonder of resting in one’s own conscious nature. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.
blocks.directed: Kṣemarāja even stresses that these stages are not simply a checklist of unusual yogic sensations. They concern the ever-fresh wonder of resting in one’s own conscious nature. Sanskrit & Trika Shaivism.

blocks.text: The universe has not become boring.
blocks.directed: The universe has not become boring.

blocks.text: You have finally stopped taking its appearance for granted.
blocks.directed: You have finally stopped taking its appearance for granted.
